name: Porto, You're Invited!
description: This event celebrates the first anniversary of Matriarca with live music, DJs, wine, and dinner. The line-up includes @sambadob.pt & @francisco_ap at The Wine Bar and @fvicencia at The Attic.
longDescription:
Porto, You're Invited! is a celebration marking the first anniversary of Matriarca. The event takes place on November 6, 2026, from 7 PM to 1 AM.

The evening features live music, DJs, wine, and dinner. The line-up includes @sambadob.pt and @francisco_ap performing at The Wine Bar, while @fvicencia will be at The Attic. The venue is Matriarca, located at Praça de Carlos Alberto, 98.

Tickets for the event are priced between €40 and €100.

longDescriptionPt:
Porto, Estás Convidado! é uma celebração que marca o primeiro aniversário da Matriarca. O evento acontece a 6 de novembro de 2026, das 19h à 1h.

A noite conta com música ao vivo, DJs, vinho e jantar. O cartaz inclui @sambadob.pt e @francisco_ap a atuar no The Wine Bar, enquanto @fvicencia estará no The Attic. O local é a Matriarca, situada na Praça de Carlos Alberto, 98.

Os bilhetes para o evento custam entre 40€ e 100€.
